text: Where first-line steps do not resolve the issue within the stated timeframe, the case is escalated to the next tier with full interaction history attached, and the customer is informed of the new reference and expected timeline. Effective Date / Version Version 1.0, effective 2026-08-08. Review Cycle This policy is reviewed annually or upon material regulatory change, whichever is earlier.
